title: Model usage

panels.title: LLM gateway (Dynamo) by model

targets.expr: (sum by (model) (increase(llm_gateway_requests_total[$__range]))) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)
(sum by (model) (increase(llm_gateway_requests_total{class="critical"}[$__range]))) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)
(sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:prompt_tokens_total", job="dynamo"}[$__range]))) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)
(sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:generation_tokens_total", job="dynamo"}[$__range]))) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)

panels.description: Requests the gateway forwarded, and the tokens the engines processed, per model over the dashboard's time range. Only the models deployed now.

panels.title: Triton by model

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"}[$__range]))
sum by (model) (increase(nv_inference_request_failure{job="triton"}[$__range]))
sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:prompt_tokens_total", job="triton"}[$__range]))
sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:generation_tokens_total", job="triton"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Successful and failed inferences per model; tokens for the vLLM-backend models only.

targets.expr: (sum by (model, class) (rate(llm_gateway_requests_total[5m]))) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)
(sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:prompt_tokens_total", job="dynamo"}[5m]))) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)
(sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:generation_tokens_total", job="dynamo"}[5m]))) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)
(histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model) (rate({__name__="vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket", job="dynamo"}[5m])))) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)
(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) (rate({__name__="vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket", job="dynamo"}[5m])))) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)

panels.title: Requests running and waiting in the engine

targets.expr: (sum by (model) ({__name__="vllm:num_requests_running", job="dynamo"})) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)
(sum by (model) ({__name__="vllm:num_requests_waiting", job="dynamo"})) and on (model) max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1)
sum by (class) (llm_gateway_waiting)
sum by (model) (rate(nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"}[5m]))

panels.title: Mean request latency

targets.expr: sum by (model) (rate(nv_inference_request_duration_us{job="triton"}[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate(nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"}[5m])) / 1e6

panels.description: Server-side time per request, queueing included.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:prompt_tokens_total", job="triton"}[5m]))
sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:generation_tokens_total", job="triton"}[5m]))
sum by (model, reason) (rate(nv_inference_request_failure{job="triton"}[5m])) > 0

panels.title: Response speed (per model, from the engines)
Averages over the time range
panels.description: Mean time to first token, generation speed per request (tokens/s, from the mean time per output token) and response time, per model.

targets.expr: (sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[$__range])) / sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[$__range]))) and on (model) (max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1) or max by (model) (nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"} @ end()))

(sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_count", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[$__range])) / sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_sum", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[$__range]))) and on (model) (max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1) or max by (model) (nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"} @ end()))

(sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[$__range])) / sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[$__range]))) and on (model) (max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1) or max by (model) (nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"} @ end()))

(sum by (model) (increase({__name__="vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[$__range]))) and on (model) (max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1) or max by (model) (nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"} @ end()))

panels.title: Generation speed per request
panels.description: Tokens per second each request gets while generating (1 / mean time per output token), over 5 min.

targets.expr: (sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_count", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds_sum", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[5m]))) and on (model) (max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1) or max by (model) (nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"} @ end()))

(sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[5m]))) and on (model) (max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1) or max by (model) (nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"} @ end()))

panels.title: Mean response time
panels.description: From arrival to the last token, over 5 min; grows with the answer's length.

targets.expr: (sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_sum", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate({__name__="vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_count", job=~"dynamo|triton"}[5m]))) and on (model) (max by (model) (llm_gateway_served @ end() == 1) or max by (model) (nv_inference_request_success{job="triton"} @ end()))

description: Usage of every model the stack serves: Dynamo through the LLM gateway, and Triton.
